purpose: What this tool is for, the school's whole week in one picture, and a quick way to the answer you need.
forWhat: This tool makes each child's papers, reads what they wrote, and shows what each child can do, skill by skill.
Educators say what was taught and approve every paper before it prints. The engine marks by the answer key, and sends any answer it is not sure of to a person.
Every colour and every number you see comes from children's checked answers, worked out by rules the school can read on [How it is worked out](/guide/worked-out).

wants.label: See how a child is doing
